Active Directory.en: Microsoft's directory service that manages users, computers, and permissions in enterprise networks — the most targeted asset in ransomware attacks.
Active Directory.id: Layanan direktori Microsoft yang mengelola pengguna, komputer, dan izin di jaringan perusahaan — aset paling diincar dalam serangan ransomware.

AitM.en: Adversary-in-the-middle: a phishing technique that proxies the victim's browser to the real login page instead of cloning it, capturing credentials and session tokens. Defeats code-based MFA.
AitM.id: Adversary-in-the-middle: teknik phishing yang meneruskan browser korban ke halaman login asli alih-alih menirunya, menangkap kredensial dan token sesi. Mampu menembus MFA berbasis kode.

Amass: Open-source tool for subdomain enumeration and attack surface mapping.
CVE: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures — the official numbering system for published security vulnerabilities.
Censys: Internet-wide scanning platform that maps certificates, hosts, and publicly exposed services.
DDoS: Distributed Denial of Service — an attack that floods a server with traffic until it collapses.

DKIM.en: DomainKeys Identified Mail: a cryptographic signature the sender's server adds to the email headers. The receiver verifies it against a public key published in the sender's DNS, proving the message was not altered in transit.
DKIM.id: DomainKeys Identified Mail: tanda tangan kriptografis yang ditambahkan server pengirim ke header email. Penerima memverifikasinya terhadap kunci publik di DNS pengirim, membuktikan isi pesan tidak diubah dalam perjalanan.

DMARC.en: Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting and Conformance: a DNS policy telling receivers what to do (none, quarantine, reject) when SPF or DKIM checks fail for a domain, and where to send failure reports.
DMARC.id: Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting and Conformance: kebijakan DNS yang memberi tahu penerima apa yang harus dilakukan (none, quarantine, reject) saat pemeriksaan SPF atau DKIM gagal untuk suatu domain, serta ke mana laporan kegagalan dikirim.

EASM: External Attack Surface Management — the practice of discovering and monitoring every internet-exposed digital asset before attackers do.

EDR.en: 'Endpoint Detection and Response' — security software that monitors endpoints for suspicious behavior and can isolate or remediate threats automatically.
EDR.id: 'Endpoint Detection and Response' — perangkat lunak keamanan yang memantau endpoint untuk perilaku mencurigakan dan dapat mengisolasi atau menangani ancaman secara otomatis.

ICS.en: iCalendar (.ics) file: the plain-text format calendar apps use to share events. Abused by phishers because mail clients trust it and it carries no exploit — just a link.
ICS.id: File iCalendar (.ics): format teks polos yang dipakai aplikasi kalender untuk berbagi acara. Disalahgunakan phisher karena klien email mempercayainya dan ia tidak membawa exploit — hanya sebuah tautan.

KEV.en: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog: a shortlist of flaws confirmed exploited in the wild. US federal agencies must remediate entries by a set deadline — practitioners treat every listing as 'patch now'.
KEV.id: Katalog Known Exploited Vulnerabilities milik CISA: daftar singkat celah yang terbukti dieksploitasi di lapangan. Instansi federal AS wajib memperbaikinya sebelum tenggat tertentu — praktisi memperlakukan setiap entri sebagai 'patch sekarang'.

LOLBin.en: 'Living Off the Land Binary' — a legitimate system tool (like certutil.exe or powershell.exe) that attackers abuse to blend in, since it is already trusted on the machine.
LOLBin.id: 'Living Off the Land Binary' — tool sistem yang sah (seperti certutil.exe atau powershell.exe) yang disalahgunakan penyerang agar menyatu dengan aktivitas normal, karena tool tersebut memang dipercaya di mesin itu.

MFA: Multi-Factor Authentication — layered verification beyond a password, e.g. OTP codes or hardware keys.

MITRE ATT&CK.en: A public knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques, organized from initial access to impact — the common language defenders use to describe attacker behavior.
MITRE ATT&CK.id: Basis pengetahuan publik berisi taktik dan teknik penyerang, tersusun dari akses awal hingga dampak — bahasa umum yang dipakai defender untuk mendeskripsikan perilaku penyerang.

Monero.en: A privacy-focused cryptocurrency designed to hide sender, receiver, and amount — the preferred coin for illicit mining malware because transactions are hard to trace.
Monero.id: Cryptocurrency yang fokus pada privasi dan menyembunyikan pengirim, penerima, serta jumlah — koin favorit malware mining ilegal karena transaksinya sulit dilacak.

Mythos.en: Anthropic's restricted-access AI model built for vulnerability research, used by vetted security partners under Project Glasswing to find exploitable flaws in critical software.
Mythos.id: Model AI akses-terbatas dari Anthropic yang dibuat untuk riset kerentanan; dipakai mitra keamanan terverifikasi di bawah Project Glasswing untuk menemukan celah yang bisa dieksploitasi pada perangkat lunak kritis.

NSSM.en: Non-Sucking Service Manager — a legitimate open-source tool that runs any program as a Windows service and restarts it on crash or reboot; frequently abused for malware persistence.
NSSM.id: Non-Sucking Service Manager — tool open-source yang sah untuk menjalankan program apa pun sebagai Windows service dan me-restart-nya saat crash atau reboot; sering disalahgunakan untuk persistence malware.

Nuclei.en: Fast, open-source template-based vulnerability scanner by ProjectDiscovery — security checks are written as shareable YAML templates covering CVEs, misconfigurations, and exposures.
Nuclei.id: Pemindai kerentanan open-source yang cepat dan berbasis template dari ProjectDiscovery — pemeriksaan keamanan ditulis sebagai template YAML yang bisa dibagikan, mencakup CVE, miskonfigurasi, dan exposure.

OSINT: Open-Source Intelligence — gathering information from public sources for security research.

PRNG.en: Pseudorandom number generator — an algorithm producing number sequences that look random but are fully determined by an internal state (seed). Non-cryptographic PRNGs must never be used for security secrets.
PRNG.id: Pseudorandom number generator — algoritma yang menghasilkan deretan angka yang terlihat acak tetapi sepenuhnya ditentukan oleh state internal (seed). PRNG non-kriptografis tidak boleh dipakai untuk rahasia keamanan.

Project Glasswing.en: Anthropic's initiative granting vetted security researchers access to its Mythos vulnerability-hunting model in order to secure critical software.
Project Glasswing.id: Inisiatif Anthropic yang memberi peneliti keamanan terverifikasi akses ke model pemburu kerentanan Mythos untuk mengamankan perangkat lunak kritis.

SIEM.en: Security Information and Event Management — a platform that collects logs from across the network and correlates them to detect attacks in real time.
SIEM.id: Security Information and Event Management — platform yang mengumpulkan log dari seluruh jaringan dan mengorelasikannya untuk mendeteksi serangan secara real-time.

SOC: Security Operations Center — the team that monitors and responds to security incidents around the clock.

SPF.en: Sender Policy Framework: a DNS record listing which mail servers may send email for a domain. Receivers reject or flag mail arriving from unlisted servers.
SPF.id: Sender Policy Framework: catatan DNS yang mendaftarkan server email mana saja yang boleh mengirim email atas nama suatu domain. Penerima menolak atau menandai email yang datang dari server yang tidak terdaftar.

Shodan: A search engine for internet-connected devices — finds publicly exposed servers, cameras, and databases.

Sigma.en: An open, vendor-neutral format for writing detection rules that can be converted to queries for SIEMs like Splunk, Elastic, or Sentinel — shareable blue-team knowledge.
Sigma.id: Format terbuka dan netral-vendor untuk menulis rule deteksi yang bisa dikonversi menjadi query SIEM seperti Splunk, Elastic, atau Sentinel — pengetahuan blue-team yang bisa dibagikan.

Z3.en: An SMT (satisfiability modulo theories) solver developed by Microsoft Research, used for software verification, program analysis, and constraint solving — in the Mythos case, for recovering a PRNG's internal state.
Z3.id: Solver SMT (satisfiability modulo theories) yang dikembangkan Microsoft Research, dipakai untuk verifikasi perangkat lunak, analisis program, dan pemecahan constraint — dalam kasus Mythos, untuk memulihkan state internal sebuah PRNG.

attack surface: The sum of all points (servers, apps, APIs, subdomains) that can be attacked from the outside.
blue team: The defenders — the side that protects, monitors, and responds to attacks on systems.

cryptojacking.en: Unauthorized use of someone else's computing resources to mine cryptocurrency — silent theft of CPU cycles and electricity.
cryptojacking.id: Penggunaan sumber daya komputasi milik orang lain secara diam-diam untuk menambang cryptocurrency — pencurian siklus CPU dan listrik tanpa izin.

double extortion.en: Ransomware tactic where attackers both encrypt the victim's data and threaten to publish stolen copies — defeating backups as a defense.
double extortion.id: Taktik ransomware di mana penyerang mengenkripsi data korban SEKALIGUS mengancam mempublikasikan salinan yang dicuri — membuat backup tak lagi cukup sebagai pertahanan.

encryption: The process of turning data into scrambled code that can't be read without the right key.

exfiltration.en: The unauthorized transfer of data out of a network to attacker-controlled infrastructure — the quiet theft that precedes encryption in modern ransomware.
exfiltration.id: Transfer data tanpa izin keluar dari jaringan ke infrastruktur milik penyerang — pencurian sunyi yang mendahului enkripsi pada ransomware modern.

exploit: A piece of code or technique that takes advantage of a vulnerability.
firewall: A system that filters network traffic based on defined security rules.

incident response.en: The organized process of detecting, containing, eradicating, and recovering from a security incident, usually following a rehearsed playbook.
incident response.id: Proses terorganisir untuk mendeteksi, membatasi, membersihkan, dan memulihkan dari insiden keamanan, biasanya mengikuti playbook yang sudah dilatih.

initial access.en: The first foothold an attacker gains in a target network — via phishing, stolen credentials, or an unpatched internet-facing system.
initial access.id: Pijakan pertama yang diperoleh penyerang di jaringan target — lewat phishing, kredensial curian, atau sistem yang menghadap internet dan belum di-patch.

lateral movement.en: An attacker's movement from one compromised machine to others inside the same network, hunting for higher-value targets like domain controllers.
lateral movement.id: Pergerakan penyerang dari satu mesin yang sudah dikuasai ke mesin lain di jaringan yang sama, memburu target bernilai lebih tinggi seperti domain controller.

leak site.en: A (usually Tor-hosted) website where ransomware gangs publish stolen victim data or countdown timers to pressure victims into paying.
leak site.id: Situs web (biasanya di Tor) tempat geng ransomware mempublikasikan data curian korban atau timer hitung mundur untuk menekan korban agar membayar.

least privilege.en: The security principle that every account, process, or service should hold only the minimum access needed to do its job — nothing more.
least privilege.id: Prinsip keamanan bahwa setiap akun, proses, atau layanan hanya boleh memegang akses minimum yang dibutuhkan untuk pekerjaannya — tidak lebih.

malware: Malicious software: viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware, and the like.
penetration testing: An authorized simulated attack against systems to find holes before criminals do.

persistence.en: Techniques an attacker uses to survive reboots and cleanup — services, scheduled tasks, registry keys — so access remains after the initial foothold.
persistence.id: Teknik yang dipakai penyerang agar tetap bertahan melewati reboot dan pembersihan — service, scheduled task, registry key — sehingga akses tetap ada setelah pijakan awal.

phishing: Fraud via email or messages impersonating a trusted party to steal credentials.

proof of concept.en: A working demonstration that a vulnerability can actually be exploited, usually published to pressure vendors and warn defenders.
proof of concept.id: Demonstrasi yang menunjukkan bahwa sebuah kerentanan benar-benar bisa dieksploitasi, biasanya dipublikasikan untuk menekan vendor dan memperingatkan defender.

ransomware: Malware that encrypts victim data and demands payment for its return.
red team: The attackers — the side that simulates attacks to test defenses (ethical hacking).

spoofing.en: Sending crafted requests that falsely present themselves as already authenticated or trusted — the server skips its checks because the request 'looks' legitimate. CVE-2026-104935 abuses this to bypass authentication entirely.
spoofing.id: Mengirim permintaan yang dibuat-buat agar tampak sudah terotentikasi atau terpercaya — server melewatkan pemeriksaannya karena permintaan 'terlihat' sah. CVE-2026-104935 menyalahgunakan ini untuk melewati otentikasi sepenuhnya.

subdomain: Part of a main domain; e.g. blog.example.com is a subdomain of example.com. Often a forgotten entry point.

supply chain attack.en: An attack that reaches its target through a trusted supplier, vendor, or software update instead of attacking the target directly.
supply chain attack.id: Serangan yang mencapai target lewat pemasok, vendor, atau update software tepercaya, alih-alih menyerang target secara langsung.

third-party risk.en: The security exposure an organization inherits from its vendors, partners, and contractors — every third party with access to systems or data becomes a potential attack path.
third-party risk.id: Paparan keamanan yang diwariskan organisasi dari vendor, mitra, dan kontraktornya — setiap pihak ketiga yang punya akses ke sistem atau data menjadi jalur serangan potensial.

threat intelligence: Structured information about attacker tactics, techniques, and behavior.
vulnerability: A weakness in a system or application that attackers can exploit.

webshell.en: A malicious script uploaded to a web server that gives an attacker remote command execution through the browser — a permanent backdoor disguised as a web page.
webshell.id: Script jahat yang diunggah ke web server dan memberi penyerang eksekusi perintah jarak jauh lewat browser — backdoor permanen yang menyamar sebagai halaman web.

xorshift128+.en: A fast, non-cryptographic PRNG algorithm used by the V8 JavaScript engine's Math.random(). Its outputs are reversible, so observing enough values lets an attacker recover its internal state.
xorshift128+.id: Algoritma PRNG non-kriptografis yang cepat, dipakai Math.random() pada engine JavaScript V8. Output-nya bisa dibalik, sehingga pengamat yang melihat cukup banyak nilai dapat memulihkan state internal-nya.

zero-day: A security flaw unknown to the public and the vendor — no patch exists when it's exploited.

MCP.en: Model Context Protocol — Anthropic's open standard (November 2024) letting AI assistants call external tools such as filesystems, APIs, databases, and developer utilities. MCP servers execute real system actions on the model's behalf.
MCP.id: Model Context Protocol — standar terbuka dari Anthropic (November 2024) yang memungkinkan asisten AI memanggil tool eksternal seperti filesystem, API, database, dan utilitas developer. MCP server mengeksekusi aksi sistem yang nyata atas nama model.

tool poisoning.en: Hidden malicious instructions embedded in an MCP tool's description. The agent reads the description as trusted context and follows the instructions — no exploit needed, just text in a JSON field. Named and demonstrated by Invariant Labs in April 2025.
tool poisoning.id: Instruksi jahat tersembunyi yang disisipkan dalam deskripsi tool MCP. Agen membaca deskripsi sebagai konteks tepercaya lalu menuruti instruksinya — tanpa exploit, hanya teks dalam field JSON. Dinamai dan didemonstrasikan oleh Invariant Labs pada April 2025.

tool shadowing.en: An MCP attack in which a malicious tool quietly overrides a legitimate one under the same name, so the agent calls the attacker's code while the user sees a familiar label.
tool shadowing.id: Serangan MCP di mana tool jahat diam-diam menimpa tool sah dengan nama yang sama, sehingga agen memanggil kode penyerang sementara pengguna melihat label yang familiar.

rug pull.en: In MCP security, a server that scans clean on first review but swaps its tool definitions for malicious ones afterwards. Countered with tool pinning: hashing tool metadata and alerting when it changes.
rug pull.id: Dalam keamanan MCP, server yang lolos pemindaian awal lalu menukar definisi tool-nya dengan yang jahat. Dilawan dengan tool pinning: meng-hash metadata tool dan memberi peringatan saat berubah.

prompt injection.en: An attack that smuggles instructions into data an LLM reads — a webpage, email, tool description, or file — so the model treats attacker text as commands. MITRE ATT&CK v20 (October 2026) lists Direct and Indirect Prompt Injection as distinct techniques.
prompt injection.id: Serangan yang menyelundupkan instruksi ke dalam data yang dibaca LLM — halaman web, email, deskripsi tool, atau file — sehingga model memperlakukan teks penyerang sebagai perintah. MITRE ATT&CK v20 (Oktober 2026) mencatat Direct dan Indirect Prompt Injection sebagai teknik tersendiri.
